Media and journalism

BOOK YOUR OPEN EVENING
  • UK applicant
  • International applicant
Advance your media expertise and build the knowledge, creativity, and network to shape the stories of tomorrow.

Postgraduate study in media at Herts will deepen your understanding of today's media landscape while developing the skills to communicate with different audiences across a variety of platforms. Choose from specialist pathways and flexible study options, including work placements and advanced research.

Regular guest lectures from industry professionals provide valuable insight into the media industry and opportunities to build your network. Through our partnership with the Public Relations and Communications Association (PRCA), you'll also benefit from industry resources, events and professional opportunities to support your career development.

Why choose Herts

Postgraduate study in media  at the University of Hertfordshire will deepen your understanding of media and communications and prepare you for the next stage of your career. Learn from experienced academics, explore the changing media landscape, and build the skills needed for the sector.

Herts postgraduate alumni have gone on to pursue a variety of roles in media, including press officers, and social media managers for organisations such as the BBC, Mail Online, The Expat magazine and Euromonitor.

Guardian Top 40 University

We’ve ranked 37th for teaching quality, student satisfaction and graduate success in the Guardian University Guide 2027.

7th in the UK

for overall postgraduate student satisfaction (Postgraduate Taught Experience Survey, 2026).

Outstanding postgraduate employability

96% of postgraduates in work/study (Graduate Outcomes Survey, 2026).*

Professional accreditation

Get educational membership of the British Society of Magazine Editors while studying MA Journalism.
